The CQC loop

Step 11: the men fight as a squad now, and the safe room has a terminal on the right wall. It is the menu: run, mode, difficulty, how they fight, your loadout, records. Step 10 underneath, the polish and scary-realism pass. Clear a room, move on. Each room holds one to three men with SMGs, pistols or a shotgun, and they get quicker, more numerous and pushier the deeper you go. The dead are your only ammunition forward of the safe room. Your points stay at risk until you walk back into it.

LookClick the view, then mouse (or drag on touch)
MoveW A S D, Shift to walk faster
Pick up or dropAim at an object, press E
UseClick. With the dot on a door, screen or pickup in reach, the click uses it
Grenades3 frag, 4 flashbang. Hold the key: your left hand draws it and pulls the pin. Let go to throw it overhand; hold Space or right mouse (aim) for an underhand lob. E or click on a live one at your feet throws it back
Open or close a doorAim at it, press E. Or just walk into it
DoorsAim at a door: click or E turns the handle and pushes it slowly away from you. Hold the click or E to turn the handle and pull it slowly toward you. Run into a shut door to breach it: with a gun you shove it with the gun, with an object with the object, empty-handed you kick it
Use / throwClick: opens or shuts the door the dot is on, presses screens, picks up what the dot is on. Click while holding an object throws it
Reset objectsR with empty hands (rooms that are loaded)
Exposure[ and ] (in VR: terminal, COMFORT)
Post effectsP (desktop only)
QualityQ cycles Auto, Low, Medium, High. Auto holds 60 fps
Graphics modeB (away from the gunsmith bench) cycles Cinematic / Sharp / Max FPS (in VR: terminal, GRAPHICS). Cinematic: the full film look, with ambient occlusion, bloom, grain, vignette, a cooler grade and soft shadows; the heaviest mode. Sharp: no film effects, so the picture is crisper and more contrasty, and it runs much faster. Max FPS: Sharp at the lowest resolution, with tiny shadows and no haze, for when frames still drop. Your body stays on in every mode
ShadowsK switches standard / soft (in VR: terminal, GRAPHICS). Takes effect next time the game loads
Light flickerL (in VR: terminal, GRAPHICS)
LeanHold Z (left) or C (right). Stops short of walls
Aim down the sightsHold Space (or right mouse). Click fires; while you aim, a click always fires
CrouchCaps Lock (toggle)
Gunsmith benchSafe room. Stand at the vise with a gun in your hand and press B (or drop it there with E) to clamp it. Click or E a part on the table to fit it, again to take it off. B locks them on and frees the gun
ShoveG at a table or loose object. Shove a table at its top edge to tip it over
KickN. Your right leg, where you look: kick a door open, a man off balance, a box across the room
JumpJ
ProfilerO
Smart detailU switches it (on by default). Far-off tiny parts stop drawing, far shadows use fewer samples, GTAO and recording ease off while frames drop. ?detail=off in the address turns all of it off at load
Hide this panelH

Step 11: the safe room terminal

Use itWalk up to the screen on the safe room's right wall. Aim the dot at a button and press E or click (Grab on a phone). With a gun in your hand the click presses too, it never fires into the screen
In the headsetIt is a touchscreen: touch a button with the tip of your controller. A ring follows your tip; pull back a little to press again
RUNYour score, the mode (standard, hardcore, practice), day or night, and Deploy new run
DIFFICULTYPick a preset from Recruit to Tier One, or fine-tune threat, men per room, damage and regen
ENEMIESTheir tactics, aim, attitude and guns, plus the rooms ahead
GEAR, COMFORT, GRAPHICS, RECORDSWhat you carry and a restock; stance, turning, brightness; performance, shadows and effects; your records

Step 11: the opposition

RolesPoint (the shotgun or the pushiest man) closes in. Support holds an angle and suppresses. Flank works round for a crossfire
SuppressionLose sight of you and the support man keeps firing where you were, through soft cover. Your rounds cracking past his head pin him the same way
Cover meA man who moves or reloads gets a teammate to fire or peek for him. Listen for the radio
HearingRunning carries about 7 m, walking 3 m, crouching half that. Opening the door into a room can turn a skilled man to it, gun up
MoraleHits, near misses and losing a teammate shake them. Shaken men hide longer and fall back to hold an ambush; aggressive ones push instead
Your gunRun dry or walk around with nothing in your hands and the pushy ones come for you
Losing youThey guess where you went from how you were moving, search it gun-first, then hold the door you came in by
Night modeTerminal, RUN. The power is out everywhere but the safe room. Some men carry weapon lights; the others can only make you out up close, when your light is on, when you fire, or when you are backlit by a lit room. Score x1.2

The loop

ThreatRises with every room you clear in a run. Clean, fast clears raise it more; taking a beating eases it, and a bad fight buys you a lighter room next
SquadsMen in a room call contact to each other, share where you are, take different cover and hold fire when a teammate is in the way
Their gunsSMG, pistol or pump shotgun. The shotgunner pushes; don't let him get close. Every gun they drop is yours, with what's left in it
GunsStep 59: the M1911 lies on the bench beside the locker with two magazines. It is stored hammer down on an empty chamber: V racks it (VR: pull the slide). R reloads, 1 holsters. The safe room restocks magazines and grenades
ScoreKills, headshots and room clears (faster and without taking a hit pays more), times a streak that grows each room
BankingPoints are at risk until you go back into the safe room. That banks them, restocks you and resets the streak. Go down and the run ends: at-risk points are lost

Step 10: polish

ListenSound comes from where it happens. Walls and shut doors muffle it. You can hear his boots before you see him
Your earsShooting indoors dulls your hearing for a moment and can leave a faint, short ring. The suppressed PPK doesn't
Smoke and dustHang in the room after a fight. Your flashlight shows the dust in the air
ProfilerO shows frame time, CPU per system, draw calls and whether the CPU or GPU is the limit. In the headset each VR session prints a summary to the console (cqcProfile()); fps is on the terminal, GRAPHICS

The building

WingsThree to five rooms share a paint scheme, a floor and a room-number letter. The plate beside each exit is the number of the room behind it
Room typesStore, records, office, plant room, locker room. The type never repeats twice in a row
CoverFiling cabinets stop more than lockers. Shelving and desks only hide you. 9 mm goes through all of them
Layout scoreEach layout is tested before it is built: clear walk, sight from the door, cover for him, floor use. Its score is in the stats line below; the browser console has the details

The enemy

ArmourPlates front and back stop 9 mm. Aim for the head, hips or legs; buckshot to the legs drops him to a knee
He hears youYour shots alert this room and the next one
Getting hitRed edges. Out of fire for 6 s you recover. Go down and you wake up in the safe room

In the headset

MoveLeft stick, click it in to run
GrabReach into an object and hold the grip button. A faint buzz means it's in reach
ThrowSwing and let go of the grip mid-swing
Heavy thingsGrab with both hands. The concrete block droops in one
DoorsGrip the lever: it turns in your hand, then pull the door toward you or push it away. Push with your open hand too. Walk into a door to shoulder it; run into a shut one and your leg kicks it open
TurnRight stick left or right
CrouchRight stick down toggles it. Or kneel for real
KickRight stick up. Your body's right leg kicks where you look (the headset can't see your feet)
JumpJust jump. Standing or roomscale, your body leaves the floor with you
Comfort settingsSeated or standing, turning style, vignette, move direction and brightness: the safe room terminal, COMFORT. Face buttons never change them, so a stray press mid-fight can't
Peek and leanLean and crouch with your body. Half walls are 1.1 m: kneel behind them
Tip a tableGrip its edge with both hands and lift. Shot through, the top only hides you

Grenades in the headset

GrenadesFrags on the left of your chest, flashbangs on the right: reach there and grip. Pull the ring with your other hand (or press A / X), then throw: the spoon flies and the fuse starts when you let go. Squeeze the trigger first to cook it. Pin still in: put it back at your chest
